passages.text: We collect approximate location from your IP address to operate the service. We share approximate location with advertising partners only if you enable personalized ads. You can disable personalized ads in Settings; this stops that sharing. We do not sell personal data. We delete your account data within 30 days of a verified deletion request, except records we must keep for legal obligations.

candidates.claim: Approximate location is collected from the user's IP address to operate the service.
candidates.explanation: The clause identifies the data, collection source, and service-operation purpose.

evidence.excerpt: We collect approximate location from your IP address to operate the service.

candidates.claim: Approximate location is shared with advertising partners only when personalized ads are enabled.
candidates.explanation: The clause describes a third-party disclosure conditioned on a user setting.
qualifiers: Only if personalized ads are enabled.

evidence.excerpt: We share approximate location with advertising partners only if you enable personalized ads.

candidates.claim: Disabling personalized ads stops the location sharing described by the policy.
candidates.explanation: The policy identifies a settings control and its effect on the disclosure.
qualifiers: The control applies to the described personalized-ad sharing.

evidence.excerpt: You can disable personalized ads in Settings; this stops that sharing.

candidates.claim: The policy states that personal data is not sold.
candidates.explanation: This is an explicit denial of sale, but it does not deny every form of sharing.

evidence.excerpt: We do not sell personal data.

candidates.claim: Account data is deleted within 30 days after a verified request, except for legally required records.
candidates.explanation: The clause states a deadline, a verification condition, and a legal-retention exception.
qualifiers: The deletion request must be verified.
Records required for legal obligations are excepted.

evidence.excerpt: We delete your account data within 30 days of a verified deletion request, except records we must keep for legal obligations.
